note: 2026-10-19, learned exact leaves (docs/m3-hybrid/learned-leaves.md): in H_3 (trick-2 decisions), the trick-3 frontier positions are solved exactly where a learned leaf-risk model (gradient-boosted integer trees, nn::leafrisk, trained on fresh network-driven trick-3 harvest rows with O_3's errors) predicts O_3's squared error to be largest, instead of the hand-picked race classes of fix G v1. The adopted O_3 (f5766a) on the stored 2,000-decision trick-2 golden set x 320 worlds: (a) no exact leaves, the baseline, which must reproduce 0.0068% overall and 0.0201% at seat 1 (1% of the worlds recomputed first); (b) G v1, race classes 1-4; (c) learned at the cost of (b) (the same thread time a world on the build VM: threshold 277338260, the model's budget 0.40, 35% of the leaves, 528 against 542 thread-ms a world); (d) learned at half that cost (threshold 1057825477, budget 0.20, 15% of the leaves, 273 thread-ms a world); each of (b)-(d) against (a) and (c) against (b) by the paired comparison. CPU only, no training. Model: data/leafrisk/leafrisk-o3-v1.json (stored as input leafrisk-o3-v1).
